parts.name: TW01_motor_housing
parts.note: Stationary gearmotor housing. Ø37.3 bore, Ø45 6809 seat, Ø40 61808 seat on the end wall, Ø12.15 bushing locator. 2 M3 heat-set inserts in the rear pillars.
parts.print_orientation: End-wall spigot on the bed. Tree supports under the flange ring only (8.5 mm overhang); the rail face of the flange is cleaned flat after printing.

parts.name: TW02_sprocket_hub
parts.note: Rotating 12-tooth bushing sprocket and hub drum; 6809 and 61808 outer-ring seats; 6 M3 × 5.7 heat-set inserts for the cap.
parts.print_orientation: Outboard face (cap side) on the bed. No supports; the 3 mm 61808 shoulder bridges.

parts.name: TW03_hub_cap
parts.note: Rotating cap with the 21-tooth internal ring gear (m1.5, generated at 7.0 mm). Print in tough PETG or PA, solid infill around the teeth.
parts.print_orientation: End plate on the bed. No supports. Ring teeth print as vertical walls; 100 % infill around the teeth.

parts.name: TW04_bearing_retainer
parts.note: Clamps the 61808 inner ring; held by the six M3 × 10 gearbox face screws.
parts.print_orientation: Clamp face on the bed, counterbores up. No supports.

parts.name: TW05_motor_rear_cap
parts.note: Dust cap over the motor terminals; grommet hole; two M3 × 8 into the housing pillar inserts.
parts.print_orientation: Closed end and both ears on the bed. No supports.

parts.name: TW06_track_frame
parts.note: Right-hand rail. Mirror for the left (TW06_track_frame_left). Final-drive boss with 4 heat-set inserts; recoil channel; M6 captive nut.
parts.print_orientation: Outboard face on the bed, placed diagonally on a 256 mm bed. No supports; the channel roof bridges 31 mm.

parts.name: TW07_idler_yoke
parts.note: Sliding idler yoke; Ø8 axle bore; spring spigot.
parts.print_orientation: Front face on the bed. No supports; 4.3 mm nose overhangs.

parts.name: TW08_spring_seat
parts.note: Sliding spring seat pushed by the M6 adjuster; spigot is the recoil stop.
parts.print_orientation: Seat face on the bed, spigot up. No supports.

parts.name: TW09_channel_nose
parts.note: Front stop of the yoke channel; two M3 × 40 through bolts with captive nuts.
parts.print_orientation: Flat on the bed, bolt holes vertical. No supports.

parts.name: 24_return_roller
parts.note: Track R5 carrier: Ø33 rims (R4: Ø28) stand 0.5 mm above the straight top run, so they keep carrying the sprung track. Two 608 bearings.
